title: You Are a Cat
about: A tap-to-play browser game for young children (about 4 to 8), made by a parent, from an idea and drawings by their daughter. You are a cat: you wake up, eat, wander the house, the city and beyond, earn hearts, play, and go to bed; it has seasons, parties, holidays, a school with lessons by school year, a diary and a bedtime story. It works on phones, tablets and laptops and can be installed as an app.
